scripts.dev: npm install --prefix ./next-js --silent & docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --watch --build --menu=0 next-js wordpress ready-check; npm run stop
scripts.start: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build next-js wordpress ready-check
scripts.generate-db-types: docker compose exec next-js npm run kysely-codegen
